title: Kissed Crispy Dutch Carrot Stew
description: A winey, crisp carrot stew simmered in a traditional ttukbaegi, finished with a splash of red wine and a hint of yellow food coloring for a midnight craving.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a ttukbaegi over medium heat until shimmering.
Add diced onion and sauté until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Stir in minced garlic and toasted cumin and coriander, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add carrot cubes and stir to coat with spices, cooking for 2 minutes.
Pour in red wine, allowing it to deglaze the pot and reduce by half, about 5 minutes.
Add vegetable broth, bring the mixture to a gentle simmer, cover, and cook until carrots are tender, about 20 minutes.
Stir in a few drops of yellow food coloring, a pinch of salt, and black pepper, adjusting seasoning as desired.
Remove the pot from heat and let the stew sit for 5 minutes before serving.
Garnish with fresh parsley or a drizzle of olive oil if desired.
